name: CashMachine_5min
summary: CashMachine_5min is a scalping Expert Advisor designed for the M5 timeframe that aims to generate frequent small profits by capturing short-term price movements. It uses technical indicators to identify entry signals and implements a quick take-profit exit strategy suitable for high-frequency trading on lower timeframes. The EA targets small pip gains per trade, relying on trade frequency rather than large individual wins.
summary_zh: CashMachine_5min是一个专为M5时段设计的剥头皮EA，旨在通过捕捉短期价格波动来产生频繁的小额利润。它使用技术指标识别入场信号，并实施快速止盈退出策略，适合在低时段进行高频交易。该EA每笔交易追求小幅点差收益，依赖交易频率而非单笔大额盈利。
strategy_analysis: CashMachine_5min的策略概念基于剥头皮交易，在5分钟图表上寻找短期价格波动机会进行快速进出。入场条件依赖于技术指标的组合信号，当指标达到超买或超卖区域或产生交叉信号时触发交易。出场条件通常设置较小的止盈目标，配合止损来控制单笔亏损，追求高胜率小盈利的交易模式。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式，但剥头皮策略中固定手数更为常见。资金管理方面，由于剥头皮交易频率高，需要特别注意点差和手续费的侵蚀效应，若缺乏点差过滤机制则可能在不利点差条件下频繁亏损。该策略的风险在于小止损容易被市场噪音触发，而频繁交易会放大滑点和点差成本的影响。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of CashMachine_5min is based on scalping, seeking short-term price movement opportunities on the 5-minute chart for rapid entry and exit. Entry conditions rely on combinations of technical indicators, triggering trades when indicators reach overbought or oversold zones or produce crossover signals. Exit conditions typically set small take-profit targets combined with stop-losses to control individual losses, pursuing a high win-rate, small-profit-per-trade pattern. Position sizing may use fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity, though fixed lots are more common in scalping strategies. For money management, since scalping involves high trade frequency, special attention must be paid to the erosion effect of spreads and commissions; without a spread filter mechanism, frequent losses can occur under unfavorable spread conditions. The risk of this strategy lies in small stop-losses being easily triggered by market noise, while frequent trading amplifies the impact of slippage and spread costs.

pros: 剥头皮策略在波动适中的市场中可以积累稳定的小额利润
5分钟时段信号频率适中，避免M1时段的过多噪音
设置了止损和止盈，有基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Scalping strategy can accumulate steady small profits in moderately volatile markets
M5 timeframe provides reasonable signal frequency without excessive noise of M1
Stop-loss and take-profit settings provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 剥头皮策略受点差和滑点影响大，交易成本侵蚀利润严重
小止损容易被市场噪音和短期波动触发导致频繁止损
缺乏多时段确认，单一5分钟信号可靠性较低
cons_en: Scalping is heavily affected by spread and slippage, with trading costs severely eroding profits
Small stop-losses are easily triggered by market noise and short-term fluctuations causing frequent stops
Lack of multi-timeframe confirmation means single M5 signal reliability is relatively low
improvements: 增加多时段确认机制，例如H1趋势方向过滤，提高信号质量
加入点差动态过滤和交易时段限制，避免高成本和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, such as H1 trend direction filter, to improve signal quality
Incorporate dynamic spread filtering and trading session restrictions to avoid high-cost and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 剥头皮策略在点差扩大时可能连续亏损，需要严格的点差过滤
高交易频率放大了滑点和执行延迟的风险影响
若缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy may incur consecutive losses when spreads widen, requiring strict spread filtering
High trade frequency amplifies the risk impact of slippage and execution delays
Without a new bar check mechanism, repeated position opening on the same bar may occur
